A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#695's current-state baseline; #730, #721). Two arms on track-p 13151fb5: shipped (explore_breadth_first 1 with stair_scum on by class) and bfs0 (explore_breadth_first 0: stair_scum alone, the arm that cut deaths at CL <= 2 from 10 to 4 at no progress cost in #721 on 9276b75a, and gave +0.8 CL and +30% DL3 arrivals in #730). Pilot as the gate, then the ladder classes-1800 starts 1-900 (verysmall, small-rest, medium, big) and the full tier (starts 901-1800), 1,800 starts per arm, read pooled and per block. Primary: deaths by 100,000 turns, exact McNemar by start, deaths at CL <= 2 and on DL1 apart; progress: DL3, DL4 and DL5 reached, mean CL, first turn at max HP 20 and 25 and at CL5 (#718), per class. The current-state baseline (353f5c09: 14 deaths in 1,800 starts, DL3 396, DL5 32, mean CL 5.24, against abd0cce1 37, 747, 88, 6.52) is the progress deficit this arm tests.
Tier verysmall: classes-1800 starts 1-45, 100,000 turns.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm. Descriptive (RULES 14).
experiment.question: On track-p 13151fb5, does turning breadth-first exploration off (leaving stair_scum alone) keep the safety of the shipped build and recover the progress it costs?
